name: The Order That Holds a Line

description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Range 60 feet

Every ally who can hear and understand you gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level, a +2 status bonus to attack rolls and AC, and immunity to the frightened and fleeing conditions, all for one minute. An ally reduced to 0 Hit Points during that minute stays standing at 1 until the minute ends, and then falls if the damage was never healed.
